seiMcp.method: real sei mcp over stdio, temp store

callHiddenTool.text: add_recommendation is not enabled on this server (started with --read-only)

seiMcp.reading: with --read-only, tools/list shows resume only, but calling a withheld tool by name answers 'not enabled on this server (started with --read-only)' while an unknown name answers 'unknown tool'. The error text separates withheld from absent and reveals the server mode. Tool names here are public, so nothing secret leaks; the pattern is what matters for non-public capabilities.
